statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while scheduled U.S. macro and Nvidia catalysts keep Stress elevated.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The main checkpoints are the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster, the cash-open response, and Nvidia's after-hours results and conference call.
headline: Low Tail, elevated event Stress before U.S. data and Nvidia
body: Overnight evidence shows Nasdaq-100 futures modestly lower while Asian equities are firmer, oil is down more than 2% and the U.S. 10-year yield is near 4.63%. No persistent one-way NQ structure is verified. Wednesday's macro cluster and Nvidia concentrate event risk without, by themselves, establishing a Tail path.

lookbackSummary: Published Tail remained low across all available preceding clock-hours. One historical slot was unavailable; the latest finalized hour was 15% Tail, 55% Stress and normal mode.
outlookSummary: Stress rises into the 12:30 UTC GDP/PCE/durable-goods cluster and U.S. cash open, then again around Nvidia's after-hours reporting window. Tail remains conditional on persistent one-way NQ structure, failed retracements and aligned cross-asset confirmation.

forecast.analysis: The Asia-to-Europe handoff can test the modest overnight weakness. Tail stays low unless NQ begins holding an extreme with shallow or failed retracements as European liquidity builds.
European participation may confirm or reject the overnight move. Mixed cross-asset behavior would cap Tail; repeated NQ extension after weak pullbacks would raise it.
European cash trading can increase range and positioning sensitivity ahead of U.S. data. Aligned rates, semiconductors and failed NQ pullbacks would be the main escalation path.
Pre-U.S. positioning becomes more catalyst-sensitive. The approaching 12:30 UTC macro cluster raises Stress, while Tail still depends on observed persistence rather than the calendar alone.
Ranges may widen as GDP, PCE and durable-goods releases approach. No outcome is known; pre-release one-way NQ structure would be the key Tail amplifier.
Final positioning before the 12:30 UTC releases keeps Stress high. Tail remains below WATCH unless shallow pullbacks and aligned cross-assets emerge before the data.
GDP, Personal Income and Outlays, and durable goods are scheduled for 12:30 UTC. WATCH reflects conditional post-release path risk, not an assumed surprise or market reaction.
Post-data repricing overlaps the U.S. pre-open. Meaningful retracements and cross-asset stabilization would favor rapid Tail normalization; repeated extension would sustain WATCH.
The U.S. cash open can amplify any post-data move. Tail remains conditional on opening-auction continuation, failed retracements and NQ holding near an extreme.
Early cash-session price discovery should clarify whether any macro move is persistent or mean-reverting. Orderly two-way trade would lower Tail despite elevated Stress.
By late morning, sustained one-way structure would need fresh confirmation. If retracements broaden and rates stabilize, the conditional Tail path should continue to ease.
Midday liquidity can produce range expansion without persistent direction. Tail stays low unless a second directional leg develops with failed pullbacks.
Early afternoon sits between the macro impulse and Nvidia's after-hours catalyst. Stress remains elevated, while Tail requires contemporaneous directional persistence.

forecast.analysis: After the scheduled results and call, subsequent structure remains unknown. Tail would stay elevated only if directional extension persists without meaningful retracement as liquidity thins.
Late after-hours risk should ease if the Nvidia reaction becomes two-way and volatility decays. Continued one-way extension would keep the conditional Tail path higher.
Into the next overnight session, Tail should normalize if Nvidia-related price discovery is orderly. Any unresolved one-way second leg would invalidate that normalization.
Post-event Stress should continue to fade if price discovery is orderly and cross-assets stabilize. A delayed directional second leg would invalidate this lower-risk baseline.
The overnight baseline remains normal if meaningful retracements continue. A renewed semiconductor-led extension without pullbacks would raise Tail from this path.
Thin overnight liquidity can magnify moves, but Tail remains low unless directional efficiency persists across multiple hours and mean reversion fails.
Approaching the next Asian handoff, lower Stress is conditional on a settled Nvidia reaction and no renewed cross-asset alignment toward a one-way NQ move.
By the next Asian session, the baseline remains low Tail if the post-event market is two-way. Persistent extension or a delayed catalyst would invalidate that normalization.
